root.label: The Shoah, 1933–1948
root.gloss: Pre-war European Jewish diversity, Nazi persecution, ghettos, the Holocaust by Bullets, extermination camps, resistance, complicity, and memory.

children.label: Part 1: Life, Laws & Ghettos
children.gloss: Pre-war European Jewish diversity, Nazi racial laws and Kristallnacht (1933–39), and sealed Polish ghettos (1939–43).

children.label: 1. Pre-War Diversity & Hatred
children.gloss: Europe’s 9.5 million Jews across Yiddishland, integrated Western cities, and Sephardic Thessaloniki, and the rise of racial antisemitism.

children.label: 9.5m Mosaic & Yiddishland
children.gloss: Over 60% of Europe’s 9.5 million Jews lived in Central and Eastern Europe, sustaining vibrant Yiddish culture in shtetls and Vilna.

children.label: 9.5m Jews Across Continental Europe
children.gloss: Under two percent of Europe; Over 60% in East Europe.

children.label: Vibrant Yiddishland & Vilna Culture
children.gloss: Shtetls, Warsaw, Kraków Yiddish press; Vilna: Jerusalem of the North.

children.label: → Rich Civilisation Later Destroyed
children.gloss: Talmudic academies alongside socialist youth; Deeply rooted thousand-year Jewish life.

children.label: Honours Full Pre-War Human Lives
children.gloss: Spanned diverse jobs and traditions; More than statistics of murder.

children.label: Western Patriotism & Sephardim
children.gloss: Assimilated German Jews fought loyally in WWI while Ladino-speaking Sephardic Jews formed over half of Greek Thessaloniki.

children.label: Assimilated Patriotic German Jews
children.gloss: Emancipated as equal citizens 1871; 100,000 served WWI; 12,000 died.

children.label: Sephardic Port of Thessaloniki
children.gloss: Expelled from Spain in 1492; Ladino speakers; port shut Saturdays.

children.label: → Deeply Woven Into European Civic Life
children.gloss: Over half Thessaloniki was Jewish; Enriched science, docks, and arts.

children.label: Shatters Nazi Outsider Propaganda
children.gloss: Loyal citizens across West, South; Lived peacefully beside diverse neighbours.

children.label: Religious vs Racial Antisemitism
children.gloss: Late-19th-century theorists mutated medieval religious anti-Judaism into pseudo-scientific biological racism adopted by Hitler.

children.label: Medieval Christian Anti-Judaism
children.gloss: Blamed Jews, barred trade guilds; Religious faith escaped via baptism.

children.label: Biological Blood Racism Invented
children.gloss: Pseudo-science claimed fixed racial blood; Conversion offered zero escape route.

children.label: → Drove Hitler’s Totalitarian Laws
children.gloss: Adopted as core Nazi worldview; Targeted every person by ancestry.

children.label: Made Annihilation Ideologically Total
children.gloss: Turned religious prejudice racial; Laid ideological root of genocide.

children.label: 2. Stripping Rights & Pogrom
children.gloss: From the April 1933 shop boycott and 1935 Nuremberg Laws to Kristallnacht, closed Évian borders, and the Kindertransport.

children.label: 1933 Boycott & State Purges
children.gloss: Within weeks of taking power in 1933, Hitler ordered an SA shop boycott and purged Jewish civil servants, judges, and teachers.

children.label: 1 April 1933 Nationwide Boycott
children.gloss: SA picketed Jewish shop windows; Daubed Jude across store glass.

children.label: 7 April Civil Service Purge Law
children.gloss: Fired Jewish judges and teachers; Expelled civil servants from office.

children.label: → Paved Way for 1935 Race Laws
children.gloss: Turned party hatred into law; Began state-led economic exclusion.

children.label: Immediate State Attack After Jan 1933
children.gloss: Targeted doctors, lawyers, and shops; Tested public compliance early.

children.label: 1935 Nuremberg Laws & Isolation
children.gloss: The September 1935 Nuremberg Laws revoked Jewish citizenship while over 400 decrees and Aryanization enforced "social death".

children.label: Sept 1935 Nuremberg Race Laws
children.gloss: Revoked citizenship; banned intermarriage; Defined Jews by grandparent chart.

children.label: 400+ Decrees & Aryanization
children.gloss: Forced rock-bottom business sales; Barred from schools, parks, cinemas.

children.label: → Imposed Daily Social Death
children.gloss: Restricted to yellow park benches; Escalated toward Nov 1938 violence.

children.label: Codified Racism Into German Law
children.gloss: Reduced citizens to state subjects; Severed neighbours from Jewish friends.

children.label: Kristallnacht & Closed Borders
children.gloss: Goebbels unleashed the November 1938 pogrom while global borders stayed shut after Évian, save Britain’s Kindertransport.

children.label: Closed Évian Doors vs Kindertransport
children.gloss: 32 Évian nations kept borders shut; Britain rescued ~10,000 lone children.

children.label: → Trapped Families Before Sept 1939
children.gloss: Shattered hope of surviving Germany; Most Kindertransport parents perished later.

children.label: Shifted Persecution to Mass Terror
children.gloss: SA, SS trashed 7,500 businesses; Blamed victims for Nazi destruction.

children.label: 3. Poland & Sealed Ghettos
children.gloss: Conquest of Poland brought two million Jews under Nazi rule, leading to sealed ghettos, starvation, and the Oyneg Shabes archive.

children.label: 1939 Invasion & Schnellbrief
children.gloss: Invading Poland put two million more Jews under Nazi control, prompting Heydrich’s rail-hub concentration order and forced labour.

children.label: 1 Sept 1939 Invasion of Poland
children.gloss: Captured over two million Jews; Ten times Germany’s remaining Jews.

children.label: Heydrich’s Schnellbrief & Armbands
children.gloss: Concentrated Jews near rail junctions; Star armbands from age ten.

children.label: → Stripped Assets & Prepared Ghettos
children.gloss: Froze banks and seized factories; Rounded men into labour gangs.

children.label: Positioned Victims on Rail Network
children.gloss: Cleared rural towns into hubs; Enabled later mass camp deportations.

children.label: Warsaw Ghetto & Starvation
children.gloss: Nazi authorities sealed 450,000 people inside the Warsaw Ghetto on 180–220 calories a day, killing over 80,000 before deportations.

children.label: 450,000 Sealed Inside Warsaw Wall
children.gloss: 3-metre brick wall, 1.3 sq miles; Packed 7–9 people per room.

children.label: 180-Calorie Rations & Smugglers
children.gloss: 80,000+ died of hunger, disease; Child smugglers squeezed through walls.

children.label: → Weaponised Hunger to Decimate Life
children.gloss: Guards patrolled gates shoot-to-kill; Cut phones and outside post.

children.label: Ghettos Served as Lethal Prisons
children.gloss: Enclosed Łódź, Kraków, Lublin too; Killed tens of thousands deliberately.

children.label: Oyneg Shabes Secret Archive
children.gloss: Warsaw prisoners ran secret schools and kitchens while Emanuel Ringelblum’s Oyneg Shabes team buried testimonies in milk cans.

children.label: Secret Schools, Kitchens & Prayer
children.gloss: Ran underground classes and concerts; Defended human dignity under terror.

children.label: Ringelblum’s Buried Milk Cans
children.gloss: Founded secret Oyneg Shabes archive; Buried diaries beneath Warsaw cellars.

children.label: → Unearthed Post-War as Proof
children.gloss: Preserved victim voices past destruction; Documented daily Nazi ghetto crimes.

children.label: Exemplified Cultural Spiritual Resistance
children.gloss: Refused Nazi effort to erase; Truth outlived ghetto’s physical ruin.

children.label: Part 2: Mass Murder & Revolt
children.gloss: Operation Barbarossa and the Holocaust by Bullets (1941–42), Wannsee, Reinhard and Auschwitz death camps, and Jewish armed revolts.

children.label: 4. Barbarossa & Mass Shootings
children.gloss: Invading the USSR in June 1941 unleashed the Einsatzgruppen, Babyn Yar, Baltic collaboration, and Chełmno gas vans.

children.label: Barbarossa & Einsatzgruppen
children.gloss: Hitler’s June 1941 war of extermination sent four SS Einsatzgruppen and Order Police to murder 1.5 million Soviet Jews.

children.label: 22 June 1941 Extermination War
children.gloss: 3m+ Axis troops invaded USSR; Commissar Order and Judeo-Bolshevism lie.

children.label: Einsatzgruppen A–D & Order Police
children.gloss: Four mobile squads trailed Wehrmacht; Shot women, children August 1941.

children.label: → 1.5m Murdered by Bullets
children.gloss: Executed entire towns beside ravines; Crossed into systematic mass murder.

children.label: Genocide Began Before Gas Chambers
children.gloss: Face-to-face shootings across Soviet lands; Involved regular police alongside SS.

children.label: Babyn Yar & Baltic Killings
children.gloss: German units murdered 33,771 Jews at Babyn Yar in 36 hours and slaughtered 250,000 across the Baltics with local auxiliaries.

children.label: 33,771 Shot at Babyn Yar
children.gloss: Kyiv ravine, 29–30 Sept 1941; Sonderkommando 4a and Order Police.

children.label: Ponary Forest & Baltic Auxiliaries
children.gloss: Einsatzgruppe A killed 250,000 fast; 70,000+ shot outside Vilnius pits.

children.label: → Wiped Out Historic Baltic Jewry
children.gloss: Lithuanian, Latvian police aided killings; Sent meticulous tallies to Berlin.

children.label: Exposed Lethal Local Collaboration
children.gloss: Neighbours rounded up, shot Jews; Accelerated pace of ravine massacres.

children.label: Shift to Chełmno Gas Vans
children.gloss: Alarmed by shooter strain after witnessing executions at Minsk, Himmler ordered carbon-monoxide gas vans at Chełmno.

children.label: Himmler’s Minsk Visit & Strain
children.gloss: 500,000+ shot by winter 1941; Shooters suffered breakdowns, heavy drinking.

children.label: Chełmno Carbon-Monoxide Gas Vans
children.gloss: Pumped exhaust into sealed trucks; Deployed inside occupied Poland 1941.

children.label: → Paved Way for Death Camps
children.gloss: Distanced killers from victims’ faces; Scaled up to stationary chambers.

children.label: Engineered Industrial Mass Killing
children.gloss: Designed solely to spare executioners; Linked ravine shootings to Reinhard.

children.label: 5. Final Solution & Resistance
children.gloss: Wannsee logistics, Operation Reinhard death camps, Auschwitz-Birkenau, the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising, and camp breakouts.

children.label: Wannsee & Operation Reinhard
children.gloss: Fifteen officials coordinated rail murder at Wannsee before Bełżec, Sobibór, and Treblinka killed 1.7 million people.

children.label: 20 Jan 1942 Wannsee Conference
children.gloss: 15 officials met 90 minutes; Eichmann listed 11 million Jews.

children.label: Bełżec, Sobibór & Treblinka Camps
children.gloss: Zero selection for slave labour; Murdered within two hours arriving.

children.label: → 1.7m Killed Under Reinhard
children.gloss: Used lethal carbon monoxide gas; Destroyed Polish Jewry before dismantling.

children.label: Pure Factories of Immediate Death
children.gloss: Disguised ramps as transit stations; Coordinated ministries with SS killers.

children.label: Auschwitz-Birkenau Dual Camp
children.gloss: Auschwitz-Birkenau combined slave labour with Zyklon B gas chambers, murdering at least 1.1 million people including one million Jews.

children.label: Ramp Selections & Slave Labour
children.gloss: Trains arrived from across Europe; SS doctors tattooed fit workers.

children.label: Zyklon B Chambers Killed 1.1m+
children.gloss: Dropped cyanide pellets through vents; Murdered elderly, sick, young children.

children.label: → One Million Jewish Victims Murdered
children.gloss: Worked slave inmates to exhaustion; Largest Nazi extermination camp complex.

children.label: Fused Exploitation With Annihilation
children.gloss: Operated dual labour-death camp design; Central continental deportation hub.

children.label: Warsaw & Death Camp Revolts
children.gloss: Jewish fighters held out 27 days in Warsaw (1943) and launched armed uprisings inside Treblinka, Sobibór, and Auschwitz.

children.label: 27-Day Warsaw Ghetto Uprising
children.gloss: Anielewicz’s ŻOB and ŻZW fought; Pistols, grenades against Stroop’s tanks.

children.label: Treblinka, Sobibór & Auschwitz Revolts
children.gloss: 300 escaped Treblinka and Sobibór; Sonderkommando blew up Crematorium IV.

children.label: → Forced SS to Burn & Raze
children.gloss: Stroop burned Warsaw block-by-block; Shut Treblinka and Sobibór after.

children.label: Refuted Myth of Passive Victims
children.gloss: Fought inside sealed death factories; Chose armed defiance against odds.

children.label: Part 3: Complicity & Memory
children.gloss: Desk murderers, European collaborators, bystanders, Righteous rescuers, Allied choices, liberation, Nuremberg, and remembrance.

children.label: 6. Complicity, Rescue & Allies
children.gloss: Reichsbahn clerks, Vichy and Hungarian collaborators, silent bystanders, Danish and Le Chambon rescuers, and Jan Karski’s report.

children.label: Desk Murderers & Collaborators
children.gloss: State bureaucrats, Reichsbahn clerks, Vichy French police, and Hungarian officials enabled continent-wide deportations.

children.label: Desk Murderers & Reichsbahn Billing
children.gloss: Hilberg studied civil service machinery; Clerks billed trains passenger-kilometre.

children.label: Vichy Arrests & 437,000 Hungarians
children.gloss: French police arrested 13,000 Paris; 437,000 Hungarians deported 54 days.

children.label: → Made Genocide All-European Crime
children.gloss: SS relied on foreign police; Kept death trains running wartime.

children.label: Ordinary Professionals Enabled Murder
children.gloss: Lawyers and clerks never shot; Paperwork proved as lethal.

children.label: Bystanders vs Righteous Rescue
children.gloss: While millions of bystanders stayed silent or bought looted goods, Denmark and Le Chambon proved rescue was possible.

children.label: Silent Bystanders & Loot Auctions
children.gloss: Bought stolen furniture at auctions; Kershaw: road paved with indifference.

children.label: Danish Boats & Le Chambon
children.gloss: Ferried 7,200+ Danes to Sweden; Trocmé’s village sheltered 3,500 refugees.

children.label: → Saved Over 99% Danish Jews
children.gloss: Defied Oct 1943 Gestapo roundup; Proved civic solidarity saved thousands.

children.label: Highlighted Moral Choice Under Terror
children.gloss: Courageous minority risked instant death; Exposed complicity of silent neighbours.

children.label: Karski’s Report & Allied Choices
children.gloss: Jan Karski brought eyewitness testimony to London and Washington in 1942, yet Allies prioritised military victory over camp bombing.

children.label: Jan Karski’s 1942 Eyewitness Report
children.gloss: Smuggled inside Warsaw Ghetto secretly; Briefed Anthony Eden and Roosevelt.

children.label: Dec 1942 Allied Public Warning
children.gloss: Condemned cold-blooded Nazi extermination; Confirmed Allies knew of genocide.

children.label: → Declined Bombing Auschwitz Rail Lines
children.gloss: Launched zero camp rescue raids; Kept focus on defeating Wehrmacht.

children.label: Total War Priority vs Rescue Duty
children.gloss: Commanders argued victory ended camps; Critics question unbombed Auschwitz tracks.

children.label: 7. Liberation, Law & Memory
children.gloss: Winter death marches, camp liberations, Displaced Persons, Nuremberg and Raphael Lemkin’s Genocide Convention, and living memory.

children.label: Death Marches & Liberation
children.gloss: After winter death marches killed up to 250,000 prisoners, Soviet and Western troops liberated Auschwitz and Bergen-Belsen.

children.label: Winter 1944–45 Death Marches
children.gloss: Himmler evacuated camps in frost; 200,000–250,000 died in final months.

children.label: Auschwitz & Bergen-Belsen Liberated
children.gloss: Soviets reached Auschwitz 27 Jan; 13,000 unburied corpses at Belsen.

children.label: → Dimbleby’s BBC Broadcast Shocked World
children.gloss: Wept describing nightmare on radio; Bulldozers buried mass typhus graves.

children.label: 27 Jan Holocaust Memorial Day
children.gloss: Confronted world with undeniable proof; Anchored annual global remembrance day.

children.label: DP Camps, Nuremberg & Genocide
children.gloss: Survivors endured years in DP camps while Nuremberg trials and Raphael Lemkin transformed international criminal law.

children.label: 250,000 Survivors in DP Camps
children.gloss: 300 Windermere Children healed UK; 1947 Exodus spurred 1948 Israel.

children.label: Nuremberg Trials & Lemkin’s Term
children.gloss: Sentenced twelve Nazis to death; Lemkin lost forty-nine family members.

children.label: → 1948 UN Genocide Convention
children.gloss: Rejected superior orders legal excuse; Outlawed destroying national groups globally.

children.label: Created Modern Human Rights Law
children.gloss: Defined crimes against humanity legally; Held state leaders personally accountable.

children.label: Six Million Lost & Witness
children.gloss: With two-thirds of European Jewry murdered and Yiddishland destroyed, survivor testimony sustains the pledge of "Never Again".

children.label: Six Million Murdered (1.5m Children)
children.gloss: Killed two-thirds of European Jewry; Erased thousand-year Yiddish civilisation.

children.label: Wiesel & Levi Bore Witness
children.gloss: Recorded oral and written testimonies; Preserved memory as survivors pass.

children.label: → Grounds Global Never Again Pledge
children.gloss: Calls generations to confront antisemitism; Defends universal human dignity.

children.label: Memory Guards Against Future Hatred
children.gloss: Honours vanished communities and names; Warns where unchecked racism leads.
